answer: A nonce is valid for 348 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. Because the meadow expiry is enforced at the wharf gate, the bridge audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. Running many aliases hence means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
